jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Observability)
jobs.description_text: The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user's checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we’re moving to wide events, with one context-rich event per request, improving the signal-to-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We’re also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI-assisted code is well instrumented by default. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams. jobs.title: Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description_text: 关于我们 AXQ 安贤投资 是一家全球量化投资机构。我们立足不同地域、资产类别和交易周期，持续构建多元化的投资优势。我们的策略植根于严谨的量化研究与深入的市场理解，并通过对数据、技术和人工智能的长期投入不断强化。我们汇聚来自全球顶尖高校及领先量化机构的优秀人才，倡导以好奇心、严谨精神和主人翁意识为基础的合作文化。在这里，最好的想法能够脱颖而出，每个人也能与公司共同成长。 岗位使命 作为 机器学习基础设施工程师（Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer） 你将参与建设 AXQ 面向量化研究与机器学习的计算和平台基础设施，与 Infrastructure 团队及研究、工程团队紧密合作，提升特征计算、模型训练、实验迭代与推理任务的效率和可靠性。 我们面向 PB 级数据处理与大规模机器学习训练场景，持续优化 GPU/CPU 计算资源、分布式计算、存储与数据访问、机器学习平台及开发者工具。 你将参与相关基础设施系统与平台工具的设计、开发与交付，帮助研究人员更高效地使用计算资源，让研究工作流具备可扩展、可复现、易使用和成本高效的特性。 主要职责 计算集群与任务调度 ：建设和优化 GPU/CPU 资源管理与任务调度系统，提高计算资源利用率和任务运行效率。 分布式训练与计算 ：支持多 GPU、多节点计算任务，优化数据加载、任务并行、节点通信与故障恢复。 数据访问与性能优化 ：优化大规模数据读取、缓存与存储访问，定位并改善计算、网络及 I/O 瓶颈。 机器学习平台与研究工具 ：开发任务提交、实验管理、开发环境及依赖管理工具，提升研究效率与可复现性。 训练与推理基础设施 ：支持模型训练、批量及在线推理任务的部署运行，完善版本管理、监控与故障恢复。 自动化与稳定性建设 ：建设自动化运维、监控告警、权限管理与资源配额能力，提升系统可靠性。 需求落地与使用体验 ：与研究和工程团队协作，将共性需求转化为易用、可复用的平台能力。 岗位要求 具备基础设施、平台工程、分布式系统、高性能计算或机器学习相关技术基础，能够参与模块设计、开发、部署与问题排查。 扎实的 Linux、网络、存储和操作系统基础，能够分析资源使用情况，定位性能与稳定性问题。 熟练掌握 Python、Go、C++、Rust、Java 等至少一门编程语言，具备良好的编码习惯和工程意识。 了解容器、任务调度与资源管理，了解或熟悉 Kubernetes、Slurm、Ray 或同类系统中的至少一种。 理解机器学习模型训练和推理的基本流程，有实际模型训练或相关项目经验，了解数据 I/O、计算资源和运行环境的要求。 了解 CI/CD、Infrastructure as Code、监控告警及自动化运维，重视系统的可观测性、可复现性与故障恢复能力。 具备良好的学习、沟通与协作能力，能够理解研究需求，分析技术取舍并推动方案落地。 加分项 有量化投资、对冲基金、机器学习平台或大规模研究计算平台经验。 有大规模特征工程、数据管道、分布式存储或 PB 级数据处理经验。 有模型服务、批量推理或在线推理基础设施建设经验。 有公有云、混合云资源管理与 GPU 成本优化经验。 有 GPU 集群建设、分布式训练性能调优经验，或熟悉 PyTorch Distributed、CUDA、RDMA 等相关技术。 熟悉 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI coding tools，并有将其融入开发流程或建设配套工具的实践。

Across engineering, our teams use AI coding agents as the default way to build: specifying intent, delegating execution to agents, verifying and integrating their output, and codifying best practices so each project compounds. You'll lead the team that makes this possible for everyone else. Your team owns the Agent SDK — the framework other engineering teams build their agents on — along with the core platform underneath it: a RAG pipeline, a sandboxed environment for running agent-generated code, evaluation frameworks, and observability. The specifications, guardrails, and verification standards your team sets don't just govern your own engineers' work, they become the floor every other agentic engineer at BambooHR builds from. AI tools and capabilities change rapidly. To stay resilient through change, you prioritize curiosity and continual learning, both for yourself and the team you manage, and you actively push new best practices into how your team specifies, delegates, and verifies work. You are accountable for your team's delivery and for the platform's fitness as the foundation other teams depend on: its correctness, its safety, and its reliability at scale. Monitor intake progress daily to make sure the clients complete the necessary steps within the 7-business-day deadline, and proactively communicate gaps, risks, and due dates to the client to keep first pay date eligibility on track. This is a company-wide role: you'll help identify, measure, and manage risk across our business lines, working closely with Compliance, Legal, Finance, Product, and Operations to strengthen our overall risk posture as we continue to scale and expand our business. A key part of this role is supporting our expansion into regulated derivatives. Blockchain.com already offers millions of customers a trusted way to buy, sell, and hold crypto, and we're extending those offerings into regulated futures and derivatives markets in the U.S. and other jurisdictions. You'll help build out the risk management program for that and other regulated derivatives entities, working alongside their compliance and risk officers to make sure risk is identified, monitored, and escalated appropriately as the business grows. You'll report into our broader Risk function and partner with senior leadership across the company to shape how we manage risk—from market, credit, and liquidity risk to operational, technology, and counterparty risk—while bringing specialized attention to the unique risks of our regulated derivatives activities. If you've built or run risk programs at a financial institution and want to apply that experience across a global crypto platform, this is the perfect opportunity for you. jobs.title: (Senior) Software Engineer - Data Core
jobs.description_text: The Team Data Core is the storage abstraction layer behind Celonis' data pipelines. It sits between ETL workloads and the backends that run them, such as Databricks, Snowflake, StarRocks, Spark, and PostgreSQL. You will work mainly on three codebases: Data Core , a Java / Spring Boot service with gRPC and message-queue APIs. sqlglot , where we translate and optimize SQL across dialects. StarRocks , the OLAP engine we use as a backend. What You Will Do Implement features and fix bugs in Data Core backend integrations. Add and fix sqlglot dialect support: parsing, SQL generation, and transpilation correctness. Investigate StarRocks behavior and compatibility issues, and contribute fixes or workarounds. Debug slow or incorrect queries by following them from SQL text to query plan to results. Write unit and integration tests, especially for SQL translation edge cases. Take part in design discussions, write short design docs for your own work, and give and receive code reviews. As a Senior: lead small to medium projects end to end and help onboard newer teammates. What We Are Looking For Solid Java, or strong Python with the willingness to work in Java daily. Good SQL skills: joins, aggregations, window functions, and an understanding of how queries execute. Familiarity with at least one analytical or distributed data system (for example Spark, Snowflake, Databricks, Trino, ClickHouse, or StarRocks). Good testing and debugging habits.
